_meta.note: Only the attached representative flow is generated.

LastName_0067.sourceSentence: I enter a RANDOM value matching "^[a-z]{4}$" in "Last Name"

PrimaryPhone_0068.sourceSentence: I enter a RANDOM value matching "10 random digits/characters from source expression {RND[10]}{TAB}{TAB}{TAB}{TAB}" in "Primary Phone"

InsuredSSN.sourceSentence: I enter a RANDOM value matching "6 random digits/characters from source expression 125{RND[6]}{TAB}" in "Enter SSN"

AuditTelephone_0075.sourceSentence: if field condition "'Product (LOB)' != \"UMB\"" is satisfied, I enter a RANDOM value matching "10 random digits/characters from source expression {RND[10]}{TAB}" in "Audit Telephone #"

InspectionTelephone_0075.sourceSentence: I enter a RANDOM value matching "10 random digits/characters from source expression {RND[10]}{TAB}" in "Inspection Telephone #"
